sections.heading: Marketo Tech Stack Guide
sections.text: > **Note:** Refer to the **[Tech Stack Index](/handbook/business-technology/tech-stack/)** to browse Apps and **[Tech Stack Applications](/handbook/business-technology/tech-stack-applications/)** to manage Apps.

sections.heading: Integrations
sections.text: To see the different systems that are connected to Marketo, please visit the [Marketo System Infrastructure Mapping FigJam](https://www.figma.com/file/efXfz35A2SRcGqB0SGCcMf/Marketo-System-Infrastructure-Mapping?type=whiteboard&node-id=0%3A1&t=Vgyw5KRPT0Zd38qT-1).

sections.heading: Data Model
sections.text: Marketo is a flat database that utilizes Email Address as the unique ID. The `Person` Object is the main object.
